Continue Regional Collaboration: Maintain and continue collaboration with regional water suppliers to strengthen our resiliency and network for planning and emergency response.

Martinazzi Pump Station:  In coordination with our consultant and contractor, we are replacing one of the faulty drives at the Martinazzi Pump Station to ensure it is operating at full capacity when called upon.
